headline: China Tests 250-Mile Electric Commuter Airliner in Shandong
summary: China's state planemaker successfully flew its 19-seat, battery-powered CE-25A electric commuter airliner with a crew on board over Binzhou in Shandong Province.
why: Electric aviation technology milestones represent advancements in zero-emission transport engineering and aerospace manufacturing innovations.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Successful flight tests of electric aircraft advance aerospace clean-energy technology.
